import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('/output/csfix'); b.mkdir(parents=True)
m='MARKER_XXE_7F3'
(b/'marker.txt').write_text(m+'
')
(b/'Foo.java').write_text('public class Foo { int a=1; }
')
(b/'ok.dtd').write_text('<!ELEMENT module (property)*>
<!ATTLIST module name CDATA #REQUIRED>
<!ELEMENT property EMPTY>
<!ATTLIST property name CDATA #REQUIRED value CDATA #IMPLIED>
')
(b/'system-ok.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE module SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/ok.dtd">
<module name="Checker"/>
')
(b/'system-bad.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE module SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/marker.txt">
<module name="Checker"/>
')
(b/'ge.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE module [
<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/marker.txt">
]>
<module name="Checker">
<property name="charset" value="&xxe;"/>
</module>
')
java=['/runtime/jdk/bin/java','-XX:+UseSerialGC','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1','-Xmx256m','-cp','/runtime/classes:/runtime/lib/*','com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main']
for cfg in ('system-ok.xml','system-bad.xml','ge.xml'):
 r=subprocess.run(java+['-c',str(b/cfg),str(b/'Foo.java')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 blob=((r.stdout or '')+' '+(r.stderr or '')).strip()
 print('CFG',cfg,'rc',r.returncode,'marker',m in blob)
 print(' '.join(blob.split())[:400])
 print('---')
